snippet.title: Gulp! v1.1
snippet.description:
Use your extending tongue to snatch all the various yummies that fall from the sky. Dont let too many yummies hit the floor, or you wont survive ! Collect coins to travel to new and exciting places with even more yummies to eat.

Gulp! is a fun casual game for everyone. (excluding yummies)

http://orangepixel.net/gulp
